expertText:
* = $0801

.clear_screen
.set_border $00
.set_bg $06
.charset lower

.var scratch, 16

.memset addr=scratch, value=#$3C, size=$0010
.memset addr=$D800, value=#$01, size=$0280
.rawtext $C400, "new macros demo ", lower
.memcpy src=$C400, dst=$0400, size=$0010

.print "new macros demo", lower
.print_char #$0D
.print "var / memcpy / memset", lower
.print_char #$0D
.print "print / print_char / print_hex", lower
.print_char #$0D
.print "repeat / while / if / wait_key", lower
.print_char #$0D
.print "irq_setup / rand / .end", lower
.print_char #$0D
.print_char #$5F

.wait_key

ldx #$10
.while X != #$00
    .rand scratch
    and #$0F
    sta $D020
    dex
.endw

.irq_setup handler=my_irq, raster=$FA

key_loop:
.repeat
    JSR $FFE4
.until A != #$00

.if A = #$0D
    JMP done
.endif
JSR $FFD2
JMP key_loop

done:
.print_char #$0D
.print "last rand: ", lower
.rand scratch
.print_hex A
.print_char #$0D
.end

my_irq:
    LDA #$01
    STA $D019
    .rand scratch
    and #$0F
    sta $D021
    jmp $EA31
